title: Establishment of the NAS signalling connection

entities.name: NAS signalling connection establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing NAS signalling connection when UE needs to transmit initial NAS message. Involves requesting RRC connection establishment and providing parameters to lower layers.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where no NAS signalling connection exists.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state entered when NAS signalling connection is successfully established.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message for tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message for extended service request.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message for control plane service request.

entities.name: S-TMSI
entities.description: Short Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity used for MME routing.

entities.name: Globally Unique MME Identifier
entities.description: MME identifier consisting of PLMN ID, MME group ID, and MME code.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity used for UE identification.

entities.name: DCN-ID
entities.description: Dedicated Core Network Identifier used for network selection.

entities.name: Suspend indication
entities.description: Condition when UE is in EMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication.

entities.name: TIN indicates GUTI or RAT-related TMSI
entities.description: Condition where Temporary Identity used in Next update indicates GUTI or RAT-related TMSI.

entities.name: Request RRC connection establishment
entities.description: UE NAS requests lower layer to establish RRC connection with establishment cause and call type.

relations.description: Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication.
Procedure includes requesting RRC connection establishment from lower layers.
Procedure may involve sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Procedure may involve sending EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message.
Procedure may involve sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
Procedure may involve providing S-TMSI to lower layers for MME routing.
Procedure may involve providing GUMMEI to lower layers for MME routing.
Procedure may involve providing DCN-ID to lower layers for network selection.
Successful procedure establishment results in UE entering EMM-CONNECTED mode.
Procedure behavior differs when UE has suspend indication.
TIN condition determines whether S-TMSI is provided to lower layers.
